# Synthetic GeoLite2 Country fixture

`GeoLite2-Country-Test.mmdb` is the synthetic/fake test database from MaxMind's `MaxMind-DB` repository. It is test data, not a licensed production GeoLite2 dataset. Source revision: `0eef25a46e20f4e96d27b951d0228efabe21323f`; source: https://github.com/maxmind/MaxMind-DB/blob/0eef25a46e20f4e96d27b951d0228efabe21323f/test-data/GeoLite2-Country-Test.mmdb. SHA-256: `6996ce679243c7f719b901ebe3b490048af2fb5965163f083857533841154fd8`.

The source repository is dual licensed under Apache-2.0 and MIT; copies of both license texts are included here. The fixture uses the documented synthetic `2.125.160.216/29` network (GB) and `192.0.2.1` (unmapped) only in an HTTP forwarding header. No deployed customer database is included.
